video_title: Melo Says Jalen Duren Decision Could MAKE OR BREAK Detroit

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Detroit's difficult decision regarding Jalen Duren's contract extension
quotes.excerpt: If you're a Detroit GM, what are we doing in this situation?

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: Detroit last year, top seed coming out of the East. Jalen Duren though, ghost in the postseason. And now, a little bit of a standoff to get this man paid. He is only 22, he is coming off of a 20 and 10 season, 60 wins for that Pistons squad. Obviously, we mentioned the playoff performance. If you're a Detroit GM, what are we doing in this situation?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Go up to Jalen Duren, say, I'm sorry, fool. You got to apologize to that man. Like granted, the performance he put up in the playoffs, obviously that's not something you just turn a blind eye to. Like he was a ghost in the playoffs, but that doesn't erase the great regular season he had, and there's not many more options out there to keep the Pistons competitive. You better make it right with Jalen Duren right now.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of retaining Jalen Duren to support Cade Cunningham
quotes.excerpt: You got a superstar guarding Cade Cunningham, you better get something back for him or you are losing a year of this dude's prime.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: If he walks out the door, or he forces himself a trade, you got a superstar guarding Cade Cunningham, you better get something back for him or you are losing a year of this dude's prime.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: So you are going to pay him? You are paying him 287 for five years?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Who else is out there? Who can you get? You got to October 1st by the way.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony's argument for paying Jalen Duren despite playoff struggles
quotes.excerpt: If I'm Detroit, I'm paying him. 22 years old. We just come off a 60 win season, regardless of what happened in the playoffs.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: If I'm Detroit, I'm paying him. 22 years old. We just come off a 60 win season, regardless of what happened in the playoffs. I'm 22, I'm going to get better. I have to get better. So if I get better, this team gets better. Let's assume Cade is going to get better. Let's assume Thompson is going to get better. Let's assume Jalen is going to get better. So now you have this core that you are going to have for the next four, five years. I'd rather go compete with that core and build around that than let this man leave.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: Where do you put how concerning or not is that playoff showing? Because it's not like he was asking my man, he wasn't like he went cold from the three-point line, he couldn't get a rebound, he like everything that made him who he was on the regular season, ghost.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The risk of losing Jalen Duren after losing Tobias Harris
quotes.excerpt: They already might be taking a step back. They lost Tobias Harris, Malik Beasley. That's why you can't get this done.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: They already might be taking a step back. They lost Tobias Harris, Malik Beasley.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: That's why you can't get this done. That's why you can't let him leave.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren's status as a premier young big man
quotes.excerpt: He's the best young big man in the NBA. One of the best. Bam Adebayo is considered the best big that we have in America.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: He's the best young big man in the NBA. One of the best. Bam Adebayo is considered the best big that we have in America.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: What's the honest? He's not American either.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: So Jalen Duren is the best big out of America, the best American big. Bam Adebayo is considered the best big that we have in America.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Duren being punished for Detroit's broader scoring struggles
quotes.excerpt: I think he's being punished for a larger challenge that this team has. We all said that they struggled to score.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: I think he's being punished for a larger challenge that this team has. We all said that they struggled to score and we were curious how much Jalen would be able to carry because their offense wasn't juicy enough. So in an era of bigs, even Bam is stepping out and taking threes now, right? In an era of bigs that offer a little bit more versatility in terms of scoring, I could see where as a team they're like, if scoring is our issue, is this the guy that we want to lock in?

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: If that's your issue, if you're going to use that point as Bam stepping out and shooting threes, Bam been shooting threes in college. Bam was shooting threes in college. Bam was a shooter. But in addition to that, one thing we're not paying attention to, if I'm Detroit, I also lost a lot of players.
